answer_1.quote: The quality of machine translation (MT) systems is periodically evaluated by academic and industry teams to measure progress and inform product deployment decisions.

answer_2.quote: Despite recent advancements in automated metrics, the metrics remain misaligned with the ideal measure of text quality...

answer_3.quote: GEMBA, the QE system that we use, is based on prompting a GPT-4 model and therefore easily adaptable to new scenarios.
methods: prompting with one-shot example in the target language

answer_4.quote: we conduct an annotation campaign for translation evaluation with the ESA and ESA AI protocols.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assign a final score from 0% (no meaning preserved) to 100% (perfect) and mark error spans with severity (minor or major).
